tars._comment: Runs from a published copy, NOT `dotnet run` against the repo. `dotnet run` executes out of v2/src/Tars.Interface.Cli/bin/<config>/ and holds file handles there for the process lifetime — the same directory dotnet build writes to — so every build failed with MSB3027 while the MCP server was up. Claude Code restarts MCP servers automatically, so killing the process never helped. Refresh after changing CLI code with: dotnet publish v2/src/Tars.Interface.Cli/Tars.Interface.Cli.fsproj -c Release -o C:/Users/spare/.tars/mcp -p:NuGetAudit=false
